protocol.selection: All four quarters of year-2 improve BOTH Brier and log loss versus industry historical average; n>=200, events>=20, non-events>=20 each quarter.
protocol.evaluation: All four quarters of year, all available 2004-2025. Raw and calibrated assessed separately, no winning model choice.
protocol.status: Retrospective audit on previously inspected data; not untouched validation or service approval.
limitations: Overlapping quarterly labels and repeated permits are not independent.
Baseline is industry historical mean, not stronger age-matched baseline.
Screening sample threshold is not a statistical guarantee.
Current snapshot reconstructs history; reporting delay and corrected records may differ from information available then.
